title: SUSPENSION ATTACHING PARTS
summary: Rear suspension attaching parts, all models: the torque control arm (trailing arm) front pivot bolt to the frame with its alignment shims, and the rubber-cushioned mount of the differential carrier at the differential carrier crossmember, plus the bolts holding the crossmember assembly. The trailing arm pivot uses a long bolt through washers and shims, with a castle nut and cotter pin tightened at "D" height; the carrier mount is a bolt through a washer and two rubber cushions above and below, with plate, lock washer and nut underneath.

fastening.to: frame side bracket (torque control arm front pivot)
fastening.note: Pivot bolt [6] goes in from the inboard side with washer [4] under its head, through the frame bracket, the shims [5] and the torque control arm bushing; outboard side: washer [4], lock washer [3], castle nut [2], cotter pin [1]. Note A: with suspension at "D" height torque nut [2] to spec, then tighten to the next notch and insert the cotter pin. Shims [5] sit between the arm and the frame bracket.

fastening.to: differential carrier crossmember / bracket under the carrier
fastening.note: Carrier mount stack, top to bottom: bolt [12], plain washer [11], cushion [10], differential carrier crossmember, cushion [9], bracket (not called out), plate [8], lock washer [3], nut [7].
Bolt [13] with lock washer [14] goes down through a hole in the top of the crossmember assembly; what it threads into is not shown.

fastening.to: outboard side of frame near the trailing arm pivot
fastening.note: Cotter pin [15] is shown with its loop on the outboard side of the frame (NOTE); the part it pins is not clear in the drawing.
